title: A perfect purely inseparable overfield exists
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field]. Write $q=1$ in characteristic zero and $q=p$ in characteristic $p>0$. There exists a field extension $K/k$ [def-pc-field-extension] such that for every $a\in K$ some $a^{q^n}$ belongs to $k$, and such that $K$ is perfect: in positive characteristic the map $a\mapsto a^p$ on $K$ is surjective (in characteristic zero every field is perfect).
